blocks.heading: What We Could Verify

figures.label: Exam Fee
figures.source: NPTEL, the government-backed course platform run with the IITs and IISc, states that joining a course is free, including videos, study material and assignments. Its FAQ lists a certification exam fee of Rs 1000 per course.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: What we could verify, and what we could not
supporting: To pass, a learner needs at least 40 out of 100 in the average assignment score and at least 40 out of 100 in the final exam, with assignments weighted 25 percent and the exam 75 percent. Some courses have different rules, so check the course announcement page.
